title: Law to let police test e-bike speed and power on the street
summary: This bill would require the NYPD, working with the Department of Transportation, to set up a program using dynamometers to measure the motor power and top speed of micromobility devices to enforce the city's ban on illegal high-speed scooters and e-bikes. Officers could use the devices only when they have probable cause that a device exceeds legal limits, and testing would focus on the 10 locations with the most micromobility traffic and the 10 with the most crashes. The NYPD would have to post an annual report by April 30 detailing how many devices were tested, found illegal or impounded.
